title: Minimum magnetic field
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for the minimum magnetic induction as B_min = 2π m v_0 / (e L).

title: Condition for passing O
description: Important: Applies the condition that the time to travel the cylinder length L/v_0 equals an integer multiple of the cyclotron period 2πm/(eB).

title: Maximum tanθ value
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for the absolute value of tanθ as 2πr / L.

title: Maximum y-velocity component
description: Important: Relates the maximum transverse velocity v_ym to the geometry by using the maximum orbital radius constraint R = r in the magnetic field.

title: Maximum y-displacement
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for the maximum displacement in the electric field as y_m = (2π² r² v_0² m) / (E e L²).

title: Electric field kinematics
description: Important: Applies kinematics (v² = 2a y) and Newton's second law (a = Ee/m) for motion in the uniform electric field.

title: Misinterpreted geometry
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assumes the electron's helical path radius is not constrained by the cylinder's inner radius r, leading to an incorrect v_ym or tanθ.

title: Sign or charge error
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect sign for the electron charge (e) in the Lorentz force or electric force, leading to wrong expressions for B, acceleration, or displacement.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Demonstrates dimensional analysis to verify the units of the final answers for B, tanθ, and y_m are correct.
